assumptions: The three setups were chosen to be runnable on a single node / single GPU, because that is the existing bench; KV-aware routing and P/D disaggregation are therefore deferred to a later phase rather than recommended now, even though they carry the largest published numbers.

A 64-token arm on vLLM is expressed with --block-size 64 (or --prefix-match-unit 64 when the physical block is coarser); I assumed this is the intended apples-to-apples arm, since vLLM's default 16 cannot represent our measured grid.

The model is treated as a hybrid Mamba/attention model (as stated in the unit background: hybrid-attention Qwen3.5-MoE), so --enable-mamba-shared-prefix-checkpoint is required rather than optional for any 64-token comparison.

Where the upstream docs publish no number (APC alone, chunked prefill, speculative decoding) I recorded 'no number' instead of substituting a vendor blog figure; the two vendor figures that were used are labelled as vendor.
The vLLM version read is docs main (banner v0.32.0) and code from the main branch; flags may differ in an older pinned release, so the benchmark phase should pin before comparing.
